name: PNG Palette Quantization
summary: Reduces truecolor 24-bit PNG images to an optimized 256-color palette, saving 60-70% file size.
analogy: Limiting a painter's color palette from 16 million shades down to the 256 most representative hues.
what_you_gain: Dramatic size reduction for graphics, diagrams, screenshots, and icons while retaining sharp lines.
what_you_lose: Smooth gradients across photographic subjects may show subtle color banding or dithering grain.
best_for: Web graphics, documentation screenshots, diagrams, and icon assets.
avoid_for: Continuous-tone portrait photography where 256 colors are insufficient for natural skin tones.
go_deeper: Uses color quantization (Median Cut / Wu's algorithm) and Floyd-Steinberg error diffusion to map 24-bit RGB to an indexed 8-bit palette.
